compile.nuance: The card operationalizes the federal Taxpayer First Act (IRC 6103(c)) consent-and-use-limitation requirement; no section in the guide corpus names the Taxpayer First Act. B3-3.1-02 is cited as the nearest governing section — it covers the 4506-C process and contains express borrower-authorization language for release of tax information (verified in text) — but the TFA-specific obligations are statutory, external to the Selling Guide.

notes: Type profile is a 1-1 tie; doc_presence chosen as dominant because the consent-documentation presence check (O-IRS-51858) is the primary deterministic control, while O-IRS-52229 is an indicator-based review. The two options fully enumerate the TFA pair (consent documented; use limited to consented purpose), so no decomposition.
